themes.name: Affordable Housing and Rentals
themes.rule: Proposals that create, convert, subsidize, improve, or regulate housing and rental conditions.

themes.name: Schools and Learning Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve schools, student services, educational enrichment, libraries, or learning opportunities.

themes.name: Public Spaces and Culture
themes.rule: Proposals that add or improve parks, gardens, trees, play and pet facilities, public art, museums, or community cultural events.

themes.name: Transit and Street Mobility
themes.rule: Proposals that improve public transit, cycling infrastructure, traffic calming, crossings, or safe movement on streets.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce environmental impacts through clean energy, waste reduction and collection, or environmental monitoring.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety
themes.rule: Proposals that improve emergency response, crime prevention, policing, surveillance, or safety lighting in public areas.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical, mental-health, preventive, specialist, or in-home care services.

themes.name: Municipal Access and Digital Services
themes.rule: Proposals that make city services, municipal information, government data, or public digital access easier to use.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Business Support
themes.rule: Proposals that support businesses, local hiring, workspaces, licensing, or workers' career reskilling.
